summary_en: City Index Fifth K.K. extended the tender offer period for Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (code 2972) from November 10, 2026 to November 30, 2026, expanding the offer period from 30 to 43 business days. Settlement commencement date moved from November 17 to December 7, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Tender Offer Terms for Investment Units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (Securities Code: 2972) by City Index Fifth K.K.
translation_en_brief: City Index Fifth K.K. announced on November 9, 2026 that it has extended the tender offer period for investment units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (securities code 2972). The offer period was originally set to run from September 28, 2026 to November 10, 2026 (30 business days), but has now been extended to November 30, 2026 (43 business days in total). Correspondingly, the settlement commencement date has been moved from November 17, 2026 to December 7, 2026. The bidder filed a supplementary notification with the Kanto Local Financial Bureau based on Article 27-8(2) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act to reflect these changes to the original tender offer notice dated September 25, 2026.
